title: Continued Training of Continuous Language Flows with Token Identity Squared Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.07721v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion and flow models have recently been extended to language modeling, generating text through continuous denoising in token embedding spaces. Pretrained models provide token representations and contextual prediction capabilities, but improving generation with limited additional training requires an appropriate connection between supervision and continuous generation. Continuous MSE evaluates a predicted vector obtained by weighting token embeddings with predicted probabilities; different probability distributions can yield the same vector and are therefore indistinguishable under this objective. We propose Token Identity Brier Flow (TIBF), which applies squared supervision directly to token identities when continuing pretrained language flows. translated_title: 基于词元身份平方监督的连续语言流继续训练方法
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流模型最近被扩展到语言建模领域，通过在词元嵌入空间中进行连续去噪来生成文本。预训练模型提供了词元表示和上下文预测能力，但要在有限额外训练的情况下改进生成效果，需要在监督信号与连续生成之间建立适当的连接。连续MSE评估的是通过用预测概率对词元嵌入加权所得到的预测向量；不同的概率分布可以产生相同的向量，因此在该目标函数下无法被区分。我们提出词元身份Brier流（TIBF），在继续训练预训练语言流模型时，直接对词元身份应用平方监督。TIBF在高斯观测模型下将网络得分与词元匹配得分相结合，使用Brier损失对词元概率进行监督，并使用概率加权嵌入进行……
tldr: 提出词元身份Brier流，通过直接对词元身份施加平方监督（Brier损失）解决了连续MSE目标无法区分不同概率分布的问题，从而更有效地继续训练预训练语言流模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes Token Identity Brier Flow (TIBF), which applies squared supervision directly to token identities via Brier loss to overcome the ambiguity of continuous MSE objectives, enabling more effective continued training of pretrained language flow models.
